apis.name: Particle
apis.why_notable: Mature IoT device cloud with REST for fleets, OTA, and device variables/functions; strong developer platform.

apis.name: Adafruit IO
apis.why_notable: Hobbyist-friendly IoT data platform with feeds, dashboards, and REST/MQTT for sensors and devices.

apis.name: ThingsBoard
apis.why_notable: Open-source IoT platform with REST for devices, telemetry, rules, and dashboards; cloud and self-host options.

apis.name: The Things Network
apis.why_notable: Global LoRaWAN network; HTTP/webhook integrations for uplink/downlink from community and commercial gateways.

apis.name: HiveMQ Cloud
apis.why_notable: Enterprise MQTT broker cloud with REST management APIs for clusters, credentials, and MQTT traffic control.

apis.name: EMQX Cloud
apis.why_notable: MQTT messaging cloud with HTTP REST APIs for authentication, metrics, and publish/subscribe management.

apis.name: AWS IoT Core
apis.why_notable: Hyperscale device cloud: shadows, jobs, fleets, and MQTT over WebSocket; full public HTTP control plane.

apis.name: Azure IoT Hub
apis.why_notable: Microsoft device management and messaging hub with REST for twins, jobs, and device-to-cloud messaging.

apis.name: Google Cloud IoT
apis.why_notable: Note: Cloud IoT Core was shut down; prefer excluding or verifying current Google device offerings carefully.

apis.name: Twilio Super SIM / IoT
apis.why_notable: Cellular IoT connectivity (Super SIM) with REST for SIMs, fleets, and usage—connectivity layer for devices.

apis.name: Hologram
apis.why_notable: Cellular IoT connectivity platform with REST for SIMs, messaging, and device connectivity management.

apis.name: Traccar
apis.why_notable: Open-source GPS tracking server with full REST API for devices, positions, geofences, and reports.

apis.name: OwnTracks
apis.why_notable: Privacy-focused location sharing protocol/API (HTTP and MQTT) used for personal and fleet-style tracking.

apis.name: Home Assistant
apis.why_notable: Dominant open smart-home platform; REST and WebSocket APIs for states, services, and automations.

apis.name: SmartThings
apis.why_notable: Samsung smart-home cloud with public REST API for devices, locations, scenes, and rules.

apis.name: Philips Hue
apis.why_notable: Most-used smart lighting API (local and cloud CLIP v2) for lights, rooms, scenes, and entertainment.

apis.name: Tuya
apis.why_notable: Massive white-label smart-device cloud; Cloud API for millions of consumer IoT SKUs worldwide.

apis.name: IFTTT
apis.why_notable: Service integration platform widely used to glue IoT devices and webhooks without custom middleware.

apis.name: Losant
apis.why_notable: Industrial IoT application platform with REST for devices, workflows, data tables, and experiences.

apis.name: Blynk
apis.why_notable: No-code IoT app builder with HTTPS API for datastreams, device control, and mobile dashboards.

apis.name: Ubidots
apis.why_notable: IoT data visualization and analytics platform with REST for devices, variables, and dashboards.

apis.name: Cayenne (myDevices)
apis.why_notable: IoT project platform with REST/MQTT for sensors, actuators, and drag-and-drop dashboards.

apis.name: Balena
apis.why_notable: Container-based edge fleet management with OpenAPI for devices, releases, and remote access.

apis.name: Memfault
apis.why_notable: Device observability and OTA for embedded fleets; REST for issues, metrics, and software releases.

apis.name: Ably
apis.why_notable: Realtime messaging (MQTT, pub/sub) often used for IoT event fan-out; public REST and SDKs.
